title: Civil Site and Project Engineers
content_text:
Civil Site and Project Engineers
Engineering
Civil / Structural / Design
Logan
Permanent | Full Time
21/9/2026
Home Each Night working on local projects in the Logan Region
Company Culture that supports & invests in progression and career development
Unparalleled mentoring prospects & support from Senior leaders
We’re looking for a Site Engineer and Project Engineer who are eager to progress their career with a leading Civil Contracting company, overseeing Civil Construction projects across the Logan region ranging from $5m - $70m.
Shadforth offers long-term career opportunities, a strong pipeline of work and is dedicated to the growth and professional development of its employees.
You’ll have the opportunity to work alongside experienced industry
professionals, broaden your skills and take the next step in your career.
Reporting to the Project Manager, you will be responsible for daily project activities to ensure project outcomes are met in accordance with contractual and safety requirements.
Key responsibilities will be:
Conduct daily site inspections and oversee onsite teams and plant, including subcontractors
Manage construction planning, programming and completion schedules
Procurement and allocation of necessary project resources
Cost tracking and reporting to the Project Manager
Quality Assurance documentation
Contract Administration, including NODs/EOTs, notices, reporting and claims
Work closely with Project Managers, Supervisors and site teams to ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently and to a high standard
What's in it for you?
Local work |  Enjoy the benefit of returning home each night, giving you more quality time with your family.
Job Stability |  Leading civil contractor with ongoing pipeline of works  that are shaping cities and communities
Career Progression |  Access to people and leaders to support and guide you through your career
Supportive Environment |  Work with skilled Supervisors who appreciate and acknowledge your efforts.
Wellness Programs |  Regular programs offering Wellness and Awareness initiatives co-designed amongst the Shadforth Teams
Diversity & Inclusion |  committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace
About Us
Shadforth are one of Queensland’s largest family-owned civil construction companies originating on the Sunshine Coast over 50 years ago. We have a strong presence across Queensland and Northern New South Wales where we have developed an outstanding reputation working across many sectors including residential and commercial subdivisions and major civil infrastructure, including roads and bridges.
To Apply
Click 'apply now' to submit an up-to-date copy of your resume and a covering letter highlighting your experience.
Shadforth is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
Check out our website for other career opportunities - www.shadcivil.com.au
